Privacy policy

Stockly · last updated 2026-10-14

In short: Stockly keeps everything you enter on your own phone. CHANGE-ME your name or business does not receive, see or sell your shop's data. There are no accounts, no ads and no analytics or tracking in the app.

What the app stores on your phone

Whatever you type or record: your shop's name, the names of your staff, your products and prices, stock quantities, sales, purchases, suppliers, and customers (including names, phone numbers and email addresses if you add them). This is saved in the app's storage on your phone only.

What leaves your phone

  • Nothing about your business is sent to us. The app does not upload your records.
  • App files. When the app opens or updates, your phone may download the app's own files from its web host (stocky-orcin.vercel.app). Like any website host, it may keep ordinary technical logs such as your IP address and the type of device or browser. These logs do not contain anything you entered in the app.
  • Backup files. If you choose Download backup or Share backup, the app creates one file with your records. It goes only where you save or send it. We never receive it.

Permissions

The app does not ask for access to your contacts, location, microphone, camera or SMS. When you save or restore a backup, your phone's normal file or share screen is used.

Your customers' information

If you record details about your customers, you are the one responsible for looking after them. Keep your phone locked, keep backup files private, and only record what you need. Depending on your business, laws such as Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019 may apply to you.

Keeping your data safe

Your data is protected by your phone's own security, so use a screen lock. The app does not encrypt your data or backup files itself. Because nothing is stored online, if your phone is lost, broken or its app data is cleared, your records are lost unless you made a backup file. We cannot recover them for you.

Deleting your data

Open Settings in the app and choose Erase all data, or uninstall the app, to remove everything from your phone. Backup files you saved or shared are separate files that you can delete yourself. Because we do not hold your data, there is nothing for us to delete on our side.

Children

Stockly is made for people running a business and is not directed at children.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date above will change. We will describe important changes in the app or its store listing.
